scripts/bench/run.py.name: Benchmark harness
scripts/bench/run.py.description: Sets up a local cluster, runs each workload class, samples memory and writes the results.

scripts/bench/smaps.py.name: Memory region breakdown
scripts/bench/smaps.py.description: Sorts a running program's memory into allocator regions so leaks and growth are easier to read.

scripts/bench/stats.py.name: Benchmark statistics
scripts/bench/stats.py.description: Turns recorded timestamps into timings, database work per run and worker memory peaks.

scripts/bench/tests/test_cluster.py.name: Cluster reader tests
scripts/bench/tests/test_cluster.py.description: Checks the parsing of pod memory, database counters and worker process listings.

scripts/bench/tests/test_fake_llm.py.name: Fake model tests
scripts/bench/tests/test_fake_llm.py.description: Checks the stand-in model's replies and its streaming behaviour.

scripts/bench/tests/test_report.py.name: Benchmark report tests
scripts/bench/tests/test_report.py.description: Checks that benchmark results render into the expected report sections.

scripts/bench/tests/test_smaps.py.name: Memory breakdown tests
scripts/bench/tests/test_smaps.py.description: Checks that memory regions are classified and totalled correctly.

scripts/bench/tests/test_stats.py.name: Benchmark statistics tests
scripts/bench/tests/test_stats.py.description: Checks percentiles, timing summaries, database deltas and worker sampling maths.

scripts/benchmark_large_table_responses..name: Large table timing run
scripts/benchmark_large_table_responses..description: Times the production-shaped big-table response path while watching server memory.

scripts/benchmark_module_cache_invalidat.name: Cache refresh comparison
scripts/benchmark_module_cache_invalidat.description: Compares how two versions of the app-code writer behave against a throwaway cache.

scripts/check_skill_mirrors.py.name: Assistant copy check
scripts/check_skill_mirrors.py.description: Confirms the two copied sets of assistant instructions match their source.

scripts/codeql_changed_lines.py.name: Changed-line lister
scripts/codeql_changed_lines.py.description: Lists the lines added or edited since the main branch so security scanning can focus on them.

scripts/codeql-local.sh.name: Local security scan
scripts/codeql-local.sh.description: Runs the same security and quality scan GitHub uses against the copy on this machine.

scripts/compute-dev-version.sh.name: Dev version calculator
scripts/compute-dev-version.sh.description: Works out an always-increasing development version number for the current commit.

scripts/coverage_check.sh.name: Test coverage report
scripts/coverage_check.sh.description: Runs the automatic checks with coverage tracking and writes readable reports.

scripts/dependabot_alert_lookup.cjs.name: Security alert lookup
scripts/dependabot_alert_lookup.cjs.description: Finds open security alerts that match a dependency update, so the right one can be linked.

scripts/dependabot_product_updates.cjs.name: Dependency update notes
scripts/dependabot_product_updates.cjs.description: Writes the release-note decision for dependency and automation-pin updates on trusted checkouts only.

scripts/design-inventory.py.name: Screen inventory
scripts/design-inventory.py.description: Lists every screen, layout family and image asset in the web app for a design review.

scripts/docs/bootstrap-manifest.mjs.name: Docs screenshot manifest
scripts/docs/bootstrap-manifest.mjs.description: Creates the starting list of documentation screenshots, with the source areas each one covers.

scripts/docs/decide-captures.mjs.name: Screenshot refresh chooser
scripts/docs/decide-captures.mjs.description: Picks which documentation screenshots to retake based on which source areas changed.

scripts/docs/package.json.name: Docs pipeline dependencies
scripts/docs/package.json.description: Lists the packages the documentation screenshot tooling needs in order to run.

scripts/docs/post-process.mjs.name: Screenshot clean-up
scripts/docs/post-process.mjs.description: Cleans up captured screenshots and copies them into the documentation project.

scripts/docs/post-process.test.mjs.name: Screenshot clean-up tests
scripts/docs/post-process.test.mjs.description: Checks that the screenshot clean-up steps behave as expected.

scripts/docs/run-pipeline.sh.name: Docs pipeline runner
scripts/docs/run-pipeline.sh.description: Runs the whole screenshot pipeline: decide what changed, capture, clean up and publish.

scripts/e2e_shard.py.name: Test split planner
scripts/e2e_shard.py.description: Splits the end-to-end test files into even batches so parallel runs finish together.

scripts/generate-sdk-types.sh.name: Code hint generator
scripts/generate-sdk-types.sh.description: Writes type hints for the automation building blocks so editors can suggest and check them.

scripts/generate-types.sh.name: Screen type generator
scripts/generate-types.sh.description: Reads the running server's description of its requests and regenerates the web app's matching types.

scripts/kubernetes/build_spike.py.name: Cluster build trial
scripts/kubernetes/build_spike.py.description: Runs real app builds in a local cluster, optionally standing in for a build host.

scripts/kubernetes/control_spike.py.name: Cluster takeover trial
scripts/kubernetes/control_spike.py.description: Proves control hands over safely when one server copy dies or a new one takes over.

scripts/kubernetes/local-kind.sh.name: Local cluster launcher
scripts/kubernetes/local-kind.sh.description: Creates, fills and tears down the throwaway cluster used for local experiments.

scripts/kubernetes/pool_drills.py.name: Task pool failure drills
scripts/kubernetes/pool_drills.py.description: Deliberately kills nodes and restarts servers to prove on-demand task pools recover correctly.

scripts/kubernetes/pool_spike.py.name: Task pool scaling trial
scripts/kubernetes/pool_spike.py.description: Shows that on-demand background tasks scale up and back down with the setting in the app.

scripts/kubernetes/pressure_driver.py.name: Load driver
scripts/kubernetes/pressure_driver.py.description: Submits sustained mixed work from inside a server pod for the pressure test.

scripts/kubernetes/pressure_test.py.name: Sustained load test
scripts/kubernetes/pressure_test.py.description: Puts background tasks under long mixed load and checks memory limits hold and all work finishes.

scripts/kubernetes/spike.py.name: Cluster experiment helpers
scripts/kubernetes/spike.py.description: Small shared helpers for running local cluster experiments and waiting for rollouts.

scripts/kubernetes/sync_latency_bench.py.name: Sync timing check
scripts/kubernetes/sync_latency_bench.py.description: Measures how long a full code sync takes from inside a server container.

scripts/lib/test_helpers_test.sh.name: Test helper checks
scripts/lib/test_helpers_test.sh.description: Confirms the shared test helpers produce stable names and clear errors.

scripts/lib/test_helpers.sh.name: Test script helpers
scripts/lib/test_helpers.sh.description: Shared routines that give each working folder its own isolated set of test containers.

scripts/lib/test_stack_lock_test.sh.name: Stack lock checks
scripts/lib/test_stack_lock_test.sh.description: Proves a second test command is refused before it touches any containers.

scripts/memory_sampler_correlate.py.name: Memory-to-test matcher
scripts/memory_sampler_correlate.py.description: Lines up memory samples with test timings to show which checks use the most memory.
